cases.name: Chasity Tacquiana Jackson
cases.about:
"Beautiful soul, five kids, she's been working as an RN for years, and then decided that she wanted to become a nurse practitioner," says (her aunt Latoyia) Roberson.

And Roberson also says Chasity was looking to get a divorce, in part, to keep her children in a more peaceful setting.

"She loved, loved, loved all her kids," Roberson tearfully said.

Her onituary said, "Chasity attended Bridgeport High School and earned her high school diploma in 2004. She attended Delta College to pursue a career in nursing. Chasity became a Registered Nurse (RN) in 2014. She was at the finish line of earning her degree of becoming a Geriatric/ Pediatric Nurse Practitioner with the completion date of August 2024.

Chasity was an irrefutably beautiful and humble soul, who was the true embodiment of love. She passionately loved her children, her mother, and her family, and had a genuine love for taking care of others. She was a nurturing by nature. Chasity will be remembered as an amazing mom, human-being and nurse."
